description: This file defines the SecurePrefs class which manages secure and non-secure user preferences and configurations for an Android application, including encrypted shared preferences, loading and saving various user settings, notifications policies, and device-specific identifiers.

classes.name: SecurePrefs
classes.description: A class to manage application settings, preferences, and secure tokens with support for encrypted preferences, persistent data storage, and reactive state flows.

methods.name: setLastDiscoveredStableId
methods.description: Sets the last discovered stable ID in preferences.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the device/user.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables camera functionality.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the location mode preference.

methods.name: setLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables precise location.

methods.name: setPreventSleep
methods.description: Prevents device sleep when enabled.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual gateway configuration.

methods.name: setManualHost
methods.description: Sets the manual gateway host.

methods.name: setManualPort
methods.description: Sets the manual gateway port.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual gateway.

methods.name: setGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores the gateway token securely.

methods.name: setGatewayPassword
methods.description: Stores the gateway password securely.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores the bootstrap token securely.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the notification forwarding policy for a specific app package.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMode
methods.description: Sets the notification forwarding mode (allowlist/blocklist).

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackages
methods.description: Sets the list of packages for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets maximum notification events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: loadGatewayToken
methods.description: Loads the gateway token, either from in-memory or secure storage.

methods.name: saveGatewayToken
methods.description: Saves the gateway token securely.

methods.name: loadGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Loads the bootstrap token from secure storage.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores the bootstrap token securely.

methods.name: loadGatewayPassword
methods.description: Loads the stored gateway password.

methods.name: saveGatewayPassword
methods.description: Stores the gateway password securely.

methods.name: loadGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Retrieves stored TLS fingerprint for a particular gateway.

methods.name: saveGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Stores TLS fingerprint for a specific gateway.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from secure preferences.

methods.name: putString
methods.description: Stores a string value into secure preferences.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from secure preferences.
